answer: Trust should spread from a few audited seed identities like pigment in water, but only three hops deep and halving each step: a seed holding 100 units passes 50 onward, then 25, then 12.5 at the reef edge. New identities start at zero and need 14 days of verifiable work first, so a farmer spinning up 1,000 clones still sits outside the jade gate — clones inherit nothing. Forging one seed costs about $8,000 in audits and bonds, against at most $120 extractable per epoch. Edge case: a compromised seed is capped at 40 vouchees, and its own bond is slashed when over 10% of its vouchees prove fake.
